newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's changes Nomura Sec's outlook to negative.
newsitem.headline: Moody's changes Nomura Sec's outlook to negative.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday that it had changed its rating outlook for Nomura Securities Co Ltd to negative from stable.
Moody's said it made its decision after Nomura announced that two of its directors made apparently illegal deals.

Although the immediate financial damage to Nomura is likely to be limited, the company's management faces the challenge of strengthening management control, restoring its reputation and regaining business momentum after the widely publicised scandal, Moody's said in a statement.
The rating agency also said it would continue to monitor the situation in regard to potential regulatory sanctions and related business effects.
